stones.label: Intersecting Network of Canals
stones.detail: Waterways criss-crossing Esmeralda where skiffs and oar-boats glide under bridges, combining liquid stretches with dry steps.

stones.label: Planless Stepped Streets, Cambered Bridges & Hanging Streets
stones.detail: Dry masonry streets following no plan, rising and falling in stone steps, arching over cambered bridges, and spanning elevated hanging streets.

stones.label: Non-Repeating Combinatorial Daily Zigzag Itineraries
stones.detail: Neither shortest line nor boredom: every inhabitant chooses a fresh zigzag route every day combining dry and boat stretches without repeating.

stones.label: Discontinuous High Routes of Cats, Thieves & Illicit Lovers
stones.detail: Higher, discontinuous adventurous paths dropping from ridgepole to balcony and contorting tin gutters along cats' courses.

stones.label: Dark Rat Sewers, Conspirators & Manhole Smugglers
stones.detail: Below ground, rats run in dark sewers beside conspirators and smugglers peeking from iron manholes with wheels of cheese, wrapped contraband, and kegs of gunpowder.

stones.label: Map Marked in Different Colored Inks (Solid & Liquid, Evident & Hidden)
stones.detail: All four terrestrial and aquatic strata—evident canals, stepped streets, clandestine roofs, and hidden sewers—can be fixed onto flat paper in distinct colored inks.

stones.label: Still-Winged Swallows, Mosquito Darts, Pinnacle Spirals & All-Point Dominance
stones.detail: Harder to fix on paper are the swallows cutting the air over roofs along invisible parabolas with still wings, darting to swallow a mosquito, spiraling up grazing a pinnacle, dominating from every point of their airy paths all the points of the city.

inner_arch: While Esmeralda's intersecting canals, stepped cambered-bridge streets, discontinuous cat/lover ridgepoles, and rat/gunpowder smuggler sewers can all be fixed onto a map in four colored inks to yield inexhaustible non-repeating daily zigzags, the airy trajectories of the swallows resist flat cartographic fixation: dropping on still-winged 3D parabolas, darting after mosquitoes, and spiraling past pinnacles, every point of a swallow's curve simultaneously dominates all points of the city below, causing any attempt to press swallow-ink onto 2D paper to burst into all-point sightlines and dissolve back into living air.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone capsule: 0 http(s)://, //, ../, fetch, external scripts/links; node --check clean; 0 console/page errors in Chromium at 1280x800 and 390x844.
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude DOM morphology: all 5 chartered custom tags present, 0 generic div/span/section/header/main/footer/nav/aside/article/button/p/ul/li/h1..h6 tags in body, 100% .esm-* CSS classes, J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-3: Stone causality: 4 toggleable colored-ink strata fixed on paper (paperFixable=true), >=10 consecutive non-repeating daily mixed-ink zigzags (repeatCount===0) + WebAudio oar/step/gutter/sewer cues; 3D swallow parabolas enacting still-wing drops, mosquito darts & pinnacle spirals while dominating 14/14 city points (dominanceRatio===1.0) and dissolving flat paper-fixation attempts (swallowPaperFixed===false).
hard_gates.HG-4: Responsive 1280x800 & 390x844 zero horizontal overflow, keyboard shortcuts (1-5, N, F, S, V, M, P, Z, R, Escape), prefers-reduced-motion honored, and <esmeralda-plate-drawer> [P] loading map.png (1600x1200) & image.png (1600x1000).
